paite: Ei lam a pang TOUPA hilou hileh, Israelte'n chi uhen.
heading: David La / Pathian, Amite Humbitpa
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,

paite: Mite'n hon sual lai un ei lam a pang TOUPA hilou hileh,
english: if it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, when men rose up against us,

paite: huai lai mah in amau eite ahon hingvalhta ding ua, i tung ua athangpaih lai un.
english: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,

paite: Huai lai mah in tuite'n ahon tummangta ding ua, lui in i hinna avuktumta ding hi.
english: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.

paite: Huai lai mah in tui kisatheite'n i hinna avuktumta ding hi.
english: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

paite: Samat bang a mat ding a aha ua hon pe lou TOUPA phat in om hen.
english: Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

paite: Thangkamte thang a pan vasa suakta bang in i hinna asuakta hi, thang aseta a, eite i suakta uhi.
english: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

paite: Hon panpihna ding TOUPA lei leh van bawlpa min ah a-om, chi in.
english: Our help is in Yahweh’s name, who made heaven and earth.
